title: Sitemap event end eligibility matches page indexing and organizer dates never invent future modifications

source.ref: Owner October 8 audit: expired event URLs and organizer sitemap dates

detail: Page hasEventEnded and the crawl reader share one import-free actual-end instant predicate, including no-end fallback and the exact boundary. Sitemap projects ends_at and applies end exclusion after the existing day-floor series fold so removing ended dates cannot promote later occurrences beyond the page ordinal allowance. A live recurring anchor remains indexable while a future or ongoing materialized date exists; ended children and exhausted anchors are omitted. Organizer public RPC offers next_starts, not a modification date, so lastModified is omitted rather than invented. Runner-free consequence probe executes the actual crawl reader, actual page end wrapper and organizer mapper with synthetic offset/ongoing/ended/boundary/series rows. No schema, public gate widening, per-event query fan-out or production data access.

verify.note: Actual reader and mapper execute against synthetic rows; no network or test runner.
